messages:
alex: Quick sync — webinar wrap: we've got 1.2k registrants, 420 live attendees. Need an X thread + LinkedIn carousel to push recording and the benchmark narrative. Can we get assets + copy by EOD?
maria: Love it. I'll own copy + cadence. Can we A/B test headline on X: 'How we cut inference costs 3x' vs 'High-performance LLMs without the sticker shock'?
alex: Yes. Prefer metric-driven on X, more narrative on LinkedIn. A/B only on X. @jordan can you export 4 hero slides from the deck? Need 1:1 and 16:9 variants.
jordan: Putting through design now. ETA 3pm. Will export PNGs + a short 10s clip of the demo.
sam: SDR routing ask — add utm_source=x_launch&utm_campaign=webinar_q1 to all links. Also can we pipe hot leads (attended + asked Q) to #sdr-inbound via Zapier?
olivia: @sam I'll set up the Zapier mapping. What's the threshold for 'hot'?
sam: Tag rule: attended=true AND asked_q=true OR poll_score >=8. Send with label 'webinar_q1-hot'.
maria: Copy drafts ready: short thread (5 tweets) + CTA to recording + 1 quote from Alex. LinkedIn long post + carousel captions. Dropping all in Drive: drive.redwood/marketing/webinar-q1/assets
alex: Adding 2 quick quotes for pickup: 'We prioritized predictable latency, not only peak throughput' and 'We reduced cost per 1M tokens by 68% in production' — pick one per channel.
olivia: Quick analytics note — add utm_content=threadA or threadB depending on variant, and make sure scheduling tags map back to HubSpot campaign id=4231.
maria: Also can engineering share 1–2 tight benchmark lines (p90 latency, tokens/sec) for the carousel? @taylor?
taylor: Yep. p90 = 78ms on 8k context, 12k tokens/sec sustained on Dedicated cluster. I'm fine with those on public copy.
maria: Perfect. I'll assemble copy + 3 creatives, schedule X posts 9am + 3pm PST tomorrow, LinkedIn at 11am. Can someone review before scheduling — @alex @jordan?
alex: Review in 30. :thumbsup:
jordan: Got it — I'll push final assets to the folder and flag for review when done.
maria: Thanks team — once scheduled I'll drop the times and short monitoring play (reply script for top comments + SDR handoff note).
